name: Frank Coughlan
bio: Frank Coughlan was Medora's postmaster in early 1884, and in February he left for a camp forty miles down the river. In March 1884 he left for New York, saying he would return as soon as possible.
mentions: The mail is now taken on and left off at Medora. This makes it very convenient for our genial postmaster, Mr. Coughlan.
Frank Coughlan started this morning for the Indian camp, forty miles down the river. Wm. Vandriesche takes his place in the post-office.
